name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Based in XuZhou City, Jiangsu province China, HotWind electronics is the biggest manufacturer of far infrared saunas in China producing 5000 infrared saunas a month. HotWind ship globally and in the 13 years they have been in business they have sold their products to customers in over 50 countries around the world.



Chinese studies have shown regular users of infrared saunas experience improvement in their medical complaints for conditions such ranging from soft tissue injury and lumbar strain to diarrhoea, tinnea and eczema. Weight can also be controlled through targeted use of HotWind’s infrared saunas and the body can be detoxified through the sweat glands of toxins such as sodium, alcohol and nicotine.



To ensure users can gain the maximum health benefits from their infrared saunas, HotWind have been using this research to improve the technology of their heaters. HotWind infrared saunas mimics natural sunlight, exercise and a traditional sauna ensuring the user gains the ultimate health benefits from these products. The wavelength of HotWind saunas has been adjusted to 5.6-15 which research shows is best absorbed by the body. These rays also penetrate 40mm under the skin, renewing cells and improving blood circulation. Recent studies have shown that regular use of infrared saunas at this range can reduce cold and flu symptoms in the early stages of the infection.
